description: This is a test suite for the 'Client' class in the 'litellm.proxy.client' module, primarily testing its initialization, configuration, and resource management functionalities using pytest.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Main client class for interacting with various resource-specific clients and HTTP interface.

classes.name: ModelsManagementClient
classes.description: Client for managing models, instantiated within the main Client class.

classes.name: ChatClient
classes.description: Client for chat-related functionalities, instantiated within the main Client class.

classes.name: KeysManagementClient
classes.description: Client for managing cryptographic keys, instantiated within the main Client class.

classes.name: HTTPClient
classes.description: HTTP communication handler for making requests, imported from 'http_client'.

methods.name: test_client_initialization()
methods.description: Tests proper initialization of the Client with resource clients and attribute settings.

methods.name: test_client_initialization_strips_trailing_slash()
methods.description: Ensures that the base URL is correctly normalized by stripping trailing slashes.

methods.name: test_client_without_api_key()
methods.description: Verifies that the client operates correctly when no API key is provided.

methods.name: test_client_initialization(base_url, api_key)
methods.description: Validates client initialization with custom base URL, API key, and timeout.

methods.name: test_client_default_timeout()
methods.description: Checks that the default timeout value is used when not explicitly specified.

methods.name: test_client_without_api_key(base_url)
methods.description: Confirms functionality when API key is omitted during client creation.
